headlines.description: The regular NFL officials returned to work Thursday night, and the fans gave them a warm welcome back before bestowing their loudest cheers upon the Baltimore Ravens, who never trailed in a 23-16 victory over the winless Cleveland Browns.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco has 2 TDs as Ravens hold off Browns

headlines.description: Matt Bryant kicked a 40-yard field goal with 5 seconds remaining and the Atlanta Falcons remained unbeaten, rallying past the Carolina Panthers 30-28 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons rally to top Panthers, remain unbeaten

events.name: New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Tom Brady led New England on six consecutive second-half touchdown drives and the Patriots rolled to a 52-28 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats score six straight TDs in 2nd half, KO Bills

headlines.description: Percy Harvin returned the opening kickoff 105 yards for a touchdown and Marcus Sherels scored on a punt return early in the third, helping the Minnesota Vikings beat the Detroit Lions 20-13 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Return TDs help Vikings top Lions, move to 3-1

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw for 209 yards and two touchdowns, and the San Diego Chargers capitalized on six turnovers by the Kansas City Chiefs in a 37-20 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers force 6 turnovers in win over Chiefs

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Greg Zuerlein kicked four field goals, including a 58-yarder and a club-record 60-yarder, to help the St. Louis Rams to a 19-13 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams drop Seahawks behind four Zuerlein FGs

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at New York Jets

headlines.description: Carlos Rogers returned a fumble 51 yards for a touchdown, and the San Francisco 49ers ran for more than 200 yards to rout the New York Jets 34-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers rush for more than 200 yards, crush Jets

headlines.description: Danieal Manning and Kareem Jackson returned interceptions for touchdowns and Matt Schaub threw two TD passes in the Houston Texans' 38-14 win over the Tennessee Titans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans roll Titans, improve to 4-0 for first time

headlines.description: Peyton Manning finished with 338 yards and three touchdown passes Sunday to lift the Denver Broncos to a 37-6 victory over the Oakland Raiders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning's 3 TDs help Broncos hammer Raiders

headlines.description: Jay Feely kicked a 46-yard field goal 6:31 into overtime to keep the Arizona Cardinals unbeaten with a wild 24-21 victory over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cards improve to 4-0 with OT win vs. Dolphins

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw two touchdowns passes and ran for a score, and the Cincinnati Bengals beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 27-10 Sunday for their third consecutive win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton, Green lead Bengals to third straight win

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw a go-ahead touchdown to Jordy Nelson in the fourth quarter, and the Green Bay Packers shook off a week's worth of controversy with a rally to beat the New Orleans Saints 28-27 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers rallies Packers to win over 0-4 Saints

events.name: Washington Redskins at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Billy Cundiff redeemed himself for a poor day kicking, booting a 41-yard field goal with 3 seconds remaining to give the Washington Redskins a 24-22 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cundiff's winning FG rescues RGIII, Redskins

events.name: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: Lawrence Tynes missed two field-goal tries from 54 yards with 15 seconds left and the Philadelphia Eagles held on for a 19-17 victory over the New York Giants on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles edge Giants as late field goal falls short

headlines.description: Lance Briggs and Charles Tillman returned interceptions for touchdowns, and the Chicago Bears beat the Dallas Cowboys 34-18 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears bully Cowboys as Romo doles out 5 INTs
